findings.title: Query simplification erases full-height roof voids and accepts a positive full-volume guard
findings.requirement_detail: Preserve small regions/holes and account for numerical error; final mechanical guard must establish material over the entire roof/floor domain. An unresolved positive-volume residual requires refusal/unverified, not a positive lower bound.

trigger.api: Public arch_mech_build ABI 2, AM_PREPARED_SLABS; no product instrumentation

findings.expected: Reject the unresolved/nonpositive roof with zero mesh, or compute a conservative full-domain lower bound that remains zero at this opening. Removing a laterally narrow residual does not bound its missing Z extent.
findings.cause: Both guards simplify the missing-material Boolean result and interpret an empty/zero-volume simplified result as complete coverage. A 1e-7 mm distance budget can erase a narrow void extending through the entire roof; subtracting that scalar from Z clearance cannot restore a valid universal roof certificate.
findings.controls: Strap axial shifts 2 and 4 nm accept on both targets; 8 and 40 nm reject with no mesh. LEGO 2 nm accepts; 8 nm rejects. Intact adjacent rays show the expected roof. These are positive-area voids, not zero-thickness contact remnants.
findings.reachability_limit: Public mechanics ABI prepared-source boundary demonstrated; not a claim that the current application/source producer emits this exact two-slab input. No end-to-end root/Rust/Worker reachability was tested.
findings.severity_rationale: Violates the stated conservative guard invariant on accepted integer input and actual exported mesh. The opening is sub-nanometre wide; this finding concerns certificate soundness, not a claim of printable physical slit resolution.

findings.title: Global transverse extrema miss a local strap lateral breakout in a nonconvex host
findings.requirement_detail: Strap entry chamfers require positive lateral containment (frozen ADR-002-v2.md, line 122); source holes/nonconvex boundaries must remain meaningful.
findings.expected: Reject STRAP_CHAMFER_LATERAL_BREAKOUT (or explicit unsupported lateral containment) instead of exporting a tunnel that opens through the parallel inner notch wall. This opening is lateral, not an intended axial mouth.
findings.cause: The notch segment y=1 is parallel to the bore axis: hi-lo=0, so it is skipped at line 685. The final min_u/max_u test sees the distant y=±15 extrema and passes even though the local y=1 wall is inside the radius-2 bore.
findings.controls: The adjacent x=10.123 section retains both walls; x=0.123 loses the upper wall over a macroscopic x interval. Deeper notch controls were retained separately; no tolerances or dimensions changed to pass.
findings.reachability_limit: Public child boundary on a simple valid integer nonconvex ring. This review does not establish current UI/root production of the exact ring.
findings.severity_rationale: Functional geometry issue with ordinary millimetre dimensions, distinct from an intentional resource refusal.

hypotheses.detail: Changed patches require identical directed boundary and consistently positive projected normals; equal oriented projected domains plus plane-slab width bounds all triangle interiors.
